Name: Anthro Aspen
Author: Emreld3000
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]The 5th entry into my anthropomorphizing series. To be used in conjunction with my own Alternate Anthro Alexis Mod, this turns Aspen into a anthro dog.

This mod features 5 outfits. I was kind of running out of steam so the outfits are a little bit phoned in. One of the outfits is just a palette swap of the other. But, there is at least an outfit for each season. I think I made her pretty cute.

Unique to this mod, you can select which outfit she is wearing in the config menu if you turn "seasonal" off. Some of these outfits could theoretically be any season. Jeanshorts and tanktops can really go with most weather.[/color][/size]

I plan on 2 more mods after this. I'll probably put less effort into them though since these mods don't seem to be very popular, so I see no need to go through this effort again.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]You need Aspen Mod[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]I would recommend you use this file with Anthro Characters Continued.
Please look at my own Alexis mod as well. This point of this mod was so one can use both spritesets at the same time.[/size][/color]
